entities.name: Ivan Kvesić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ivan Kvesić is a Croatian karateka athlete who won a gold medal at the 2018 World Karate Championships held in Madrid, Spain. He represented Croatia at the 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo, Japan. He competed in the men's +75 kg event.
